# möbius for macOS 0.10.31

Explore memory as linked pages or a graph, follow links and backlinks, and edit page descriptions and content. Graph dragging remains responsive with Reduce Motion, and cached link degrees reduce simulation work.

Bundles gateway 0.16.49 with scoped memory pages, idle consolidation and protected version-checked patches. Requires protocol-99 clients. Existing legacy memory records are not automatically converted into pages; chats and other gateway state remain in place.
